hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -q 'git commit' && { git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | while read f; do if git show :"$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '(apiKey|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|password|token|-----BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ Potential secret detected in staged files. Use git commit --no-verify to bypass (not recommended).","continue":false,"stopReason":"Secret pattern detected"}' | jq -r '.'; exit 1; fi; done; } || true
